name: Tax Refund Notice
summary: Confirms that the Tax Authority owes you money for a tax year and shows how and when the refund will be paid.

guidance.primaryNextStep: Check that the refund amount and bank details are correct, then monitor the payment window before following up.
guidance.deadlineSummary: The date or expected window on the notice
guidance.appliesWhen: the Tax Authority says you overpaid and plans to send money back
guidance.recommendedChannel: Use the refund inquiry channel printed on the notice if the transfer is delayed or the bank details changed.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: the bank account is outdated, the amount seems wrong, or the refund does not arrive in the stated window
guidance.whatToVerify: Verify the tax year, refund amount, receiving bank account, and expected transfer timing.

sections.explainer: Tax year: the period covered by the refund. Compare it with your application.
Refund amount: check the calculation including offsets, credits and earlier payments.
Bank account: the account designated for the refund. A closed or incorrect account can delay transfer.
sections.actionRequired: Check the account; if it is wrong, ask about the official update procedure.

sections.explainer: Transfer timing: check whether an exact date or an expected processing window is given. Additional checks can affect timing.
sections.deadline: The date or expected window on the notice

sections.explainer: Inquiry or correction: how to contact the office if the amount is wrong, the account changed or the transfer has not arrived.
sections.actionRequired: If the transfer has not arrived in the stated period, contact the authority and quote the letter number.

sources.title: רשות המסים — בקשה להחזר מס (טופס 135)
sources.scope: Official service information on income evidence, bank-account verification, assessment notices and refund transfers. Indexed official-page content was checked; direct automated opening returned HTTP 403. This is background for refund and income-document guidance, not validation of an individual notice.
